script_text: Pisces, Neptune is igniting your 12th House this week — expect a sudden revelation that completely reshapes everything you thought you knew. Thursday through Sunday, Mercury retrograde exits your 3rd House, clearing miscommunications. Trust your intuition when making financial decisions this week, especially on Wednesday or Thursday. Follow for daily astrological updates from me.
